# MegaOrbitals cannon list

<!-- Generated by ConfigExporter during `mvn package`. Do not edit by hand. -->

All **1322** cannons: 322 hand-made cannons and 1000 arsenal (payload + pattern) cannons.

Fire one with `/orbital <id>` or give it with `/orbitalgive <id>`. Every cannon's settings are in `plugins/MegaOrbitals/configs/<id>.yml`.

| Tier | Cannons |
|---|---|
| Common | 204 |
| Rare | 830 |
| Epic | 224 |
| Legendary | 64 |

## The arsenal

Each arsenal cannon pairs one **payload** (what happens at every impact) with one **pattern** (where and when the impacts land). The id is the two names joined, in lower case: Frost + Spiral = `frostspiral`. Every arsenal cannon has the settings `power`, `radius`, `count` and `interval-ticks`.

A cannon's tier comes from the payload's weight plus the pattern's weight: 0-1 common, 2-3 rare, 4 epic, 5-6 legendary. Its menu tab is the payload's tab.

| Payload | Effect | Menu tab | Weight | Breaks blocks |

### Patterns

| Pattern | How it lands | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| Strike | In one massive hit | 0 |
| Shower | Raining down all over the area | 1 |
| Ring | In a ring around the target | 1 |
| Nova | In rings that spread outward | 2 |
| Implosion | In rings that close in on the centre | 2 |
| Lance | In a straight line where you aim | 1 |
| Cross | In a giant cross | 1 |
| Spiral | Spiralling out from the centre | 2 |
| Grid | In a grid that sweeps the area row by row | 2 |
| Barrage | In a relentless rapid-fire barrage | 3 |
| Chain | Jumping from target to target | 2 |
| Seeker | On every target in range, one after another | 2 |
| Carpet | Carpet-bombing forward in rows | 3 |
| Star | In the shape of a five-pointed star | 2 |
| Orbit | Circling the target over and over | 1 |
| Pillar | Stacked in a column falling from the sky | 1 |
| Cluster | As one hit that splits into many | 1 |
| Mines | As hidden mines that go off when someone walks by | 1 |
| Pulse | Pulsing on the same spot again and again | 1 |
| Zigzag | Zigzagging forward where you aim | 1 |
| Comet | Streaking across the area like a comet | 2 |
| Halo | In two rings, inner then outer | 2 |
| Fan | Fanning out in a cone where you aim | 1 |
| Volley | On everyone in range at the same moment | 2 |
| Delta | Tracing a giant triangle | 1 |
